title: Desktop Ran The Internet For 20 Years. Mobile Took Over.
source: StatCounter GlobalStats, worldwide platform market share (annual averages, desktop vs mobile, tablet excluded). Mobile: 31% (2015), 38% (2016), 50% (2017), 53% (2019), 57% (2021), 58% (2023). Desktop: 69% (2015), 62% (2016), 50% (2017), 47% (2019), 43% (2021), 42% (2023). Figures approximate annual averages.
